body:
When using SQLite's version `\db\QueryBuilder::batchInsert()`, SQLite will fail when inserting more than 500 rows at a time due to [SQLite's limitation of 500 terms per select statement](http://www.sqlite.org/limits.html#max_compound_select). This can be overcome by using the [newer insert syntax for SQLite >= 3.7.11](http://www.sqlite.org/releaselog/3_7_11.html). 

This issue is related to pull request #3545

note that `helper::_batchInsert()` in the trace is just a wrapper:

```
public static function _batchInsert($table, $columns, $data) {
    Yii::$app
            ->db
            ->createCommand()
            ->batchInsert($table, $columns, $data)
            ->execute();
}
```
